feeds.title: Good Times
feeds.description: Good Times is a blog dedicated to promoting a positive and fulfilling lifestyle for seniors. Explore articles on health, wellness, travel, hobbies, and inspiring stories of successful aging. Good Times aims to empower seniors and provide them with resources and information to make the most of their golden years.

feeds.title: Research Institute for Aging
feeds.description: The Research Institute for Aging's blog delves into cutting-edge research and initiatives in the field of aging. Explore articles on gerontology, health promotion, dementia care, and social engagement for seniors. The Research Institute for Aging is dedicated to improving the quality of life for older adults through evidence-based research and knowledge translation.

feeds.title: Active Aging Research Team Blog
feeds.description: The Active Aging Research Team Blog focuses on promoting active and healthy lifestyles for older adults. Explore articles on physical fitness, cognitive health, social engagement, and community programs for seniors. The Active Aging Research Team aims to empower older adults to lead active, independent, and fulfilling lives.

feeds.title: Canadian Seniors Directory Blog
feeds.description: Canadian Seniors Directory Blog is a comprehensive resource for seniors, their families, and caregivers. Discover articles on housing options, healthcare services, retirement planning, and lifestyle choices. Canadian Seniors Directory Blog aims to connect seniors with the information and services they need to navigate their aging journey.

feeds.title: THE CAREGIVERS' LIVING ROOM
feeds.description: THE CAREGIVERS' LIVING ROOM is a blog dedicated to supporting family caregivers. Discover articles on self-care, caregiver resources, stress management, and navigating the challenges of caregiving. THE CAREGIVERS' LIVING ROOM provides a space for caregivers to find comfort, advice, and a sense of community.

feeds.title: Global Aging and Community Initiative
feeds.description: The Global Aging and Community Initiative (GACI) is a blog and research platform focused on the study of aging and community development worldwide. Founded with a mission to promote the well-being and inclusion of older adults in diverse communities, GACI explores topics such as social policies, healthcare systems, intergenerational relationships, and age-friendly environments.

feeds.title: AGING DISGRACEFULLY
feeds.description: A journey of exploration and discovery of who I am becoming during the aging process. A great big bang-up HURRAH! that I'm alive. A lot of talk about sundry and miscellaneous stuff & nonsense that may or may not have relevance; they may not even make sense (remember, I'm menopausal!). But I'm hoping they'll be fun.

feeds.title: Ledoux Lagoon
feeds.description: Age Better with helpful tips for personal growth, health, beauty, and lifestyle. As we age, life can leave us a little tired, a little lax, and too immersed in the daily minutia. Ledoux Lagoon is a destination for you to awaken those youthful senses; a place to replenish and rediscover!

feeds.title: Senior Helpers Blog
feeds.description: Senior Helpers regularly add tips for seniors and the elderly to live life to the fullest and make their daily life easier. Our mission is to ensure a better quality of life for our elderly clients and their families by providing dependable and affordable care. We are a trusted and respected organization that takes a responsible role in supporting our clients and their families, our employees, and our community.

feeds.title: Dying With Dignity Canada Blog
feeds.description: Dying With Dignity Canada is a national human-rights charity committed to improving the quality of dying, protecting end-of-life rights, and helping Canadians avoid unwanted suffering. We ensure access to quality end-of-life choice and care through advocacy, education, and support.

feeds.title: Age Safe Canada Blog
feeds.description: Age Safe Canada Blog provides information and resources to promote safety and well-being for seniors. Discover articles on fall prevention, home safety, medication management, and fraud protection. Age Safe Canada Blog aims to raise awareness and provide practical advice to help seniors live safely and independently.
